description: This file is an HTML custom element definition for 'iron-icon' as part of the Polymer library. It includes import statements, styling, element templates, and a script defining the element's behavior, properties, and methods.

classes.name: iron-icon
classes.description: A custom element that displays an icon, either from an iconset or a source image.

methods.name: _iconChanged
methods.description: Observer method called when the 'icon' property changes; updates the icon name and set.

methods.name: _srcChanged
methods.description: Observer method called when the 'src' property changes; updates the displayed image.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Method to update the icon displayed, either from an iconset or via src image.
